selfReport: Yes. I recognized the story and situations as closely resembling Detroit: Become Human, with names changed: Cato, Mira, and Elan correspond to Connor, Kara, and Markus, and several scenes and relationships were familiar. That recognition gave me a general sense that choices could have branching consequences and made some situations feel familiar. I cannot cleanly separate that familiarity from every judgment, but I tried to choose from the information in each presented scene rather than rely on remembered outcomes; I did not deliberately select a route from prior knowledge.
